_meta.title: Green finance schemes and products - sample catalogue
_meta.disclaimer: SAMPLE CATALOGUE for demonstration. Scheme terms and indicative rates are not verified live and may change. Always confirm eligibility, rates and fees with the provider. Rates marked unverified are indicative only.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana - Residential Rooftop CFA
schemes.provider: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
schemes.description: Central financial assistance for residential rooftop solar installations with net metering.
schemes.eligibility: Residential households with a valid electricity connection and suitable roof; installation through a registered vendor.
schemes.benefits: Central subsidy of Rs 30,000/kW up to 2 kW and Rs 18,000/kW for the third kW, capped at Rs 78,000 for residential systems.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Component B - Solar Pump Subsidy
schemes.description: Support for standalone solar agriculture pumps and grid-connected solarisation of pumps.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, cooperatives and panchayats meeting state nodal agency criteria.
schemes.benefits: Capital subsidy and low-interest farmer financing depending on the state and component.

schemes.name: IREDA Renewable Energy Project Loan
schemes.description: Term debt for solar, wind, small hydro, biomass and emerging clean-energy projects.
schemes.eligibility: Registered companies, SPVs and eligible project developers with a bankable project.
schemes.benefits: Long-tenure project debt and structured finance for renewable generation assets.
schemes.rate_note: Indicative sample range. Rates are lender- and project-specific; verify with IREDA.

schemes.name: SBI Surya Ghar Home Solar Loan
schemes.description: Collateral-free consumer loan for residential rooftop solar under the national rooftop programme.
schemes.eligibility: Residential customers with a satisfactory credit profile and approved vendor quotation.
schemes.benefits: Concessional consumer loan with flexible repayment; subsidy credited through the national portal.
schemes.rate_note: Indicative sample range. Final rate depends on credit assessment; verify with SBI.

schemes.name: RBI Priority Sector Green Lending
schemes.provider: Reserve Bank of India / Scheduled Commercial Banks
schemes.description: Priority-sector classification support for eligible renewable energy and sanitation lending.
schemes.eligibility: Banks lending to eligible renewable energy projects within RBI priority-sector guidelines.
schemes.benefits: Supports bank credit flow to renewable energy through priority-sector treatment.
schemes.rate_note: Framework guidance - rates are set by individual banks.

schemes.name: REC Green Bond Programme
schemes.description: Green bond issuances funding renewable generation and transmission infrastructure.
schemes.eligibility: Institutional and eligible retail investors under the applicable issue documents.
schemes.benefits: Fixed-income exposure to a renewable-focused public-sector issuer.
schemes.rate_note: Illustrative coupon range for sample data only; verify the current issue document.

schemes.name: PFC Green Energy Financing
schemes.description: Long-term debt for generation, transmission and distribution including renewable capacity.
schemes.eligibility: Power-sector utilities, developers and state-owned entities with approved projects.
schemes.benefits: Large-ticket project finance with long tenors.
schemes.rate_note: Indicative sample range; verify with PFC.

schemes.name: SECI Renewable Power Procurement (VGF / Tariff-based)
schemes.description: Competitive procurement of renewable power through SECI tenders and power purchase agreements.
schemes.eligibility: Qualified developers participating in SECI tenders and agreeing to PPA terms.
schemes.benefits: Long-term offtake and predictable tariff revenue for commissioned projects.

schemes.name: State Rooftop Solar Net-Metering Programme
schemes.description: State-level facilitation for residential and institutional rooftop solar with net metering.
schemes.eligibility: Consumers in participating states with a sanctioned load and technically feasible connection.
schemes.benefits: Net-metering credit for exported units plus state-specific incentives where notified.

schemes.name: MSME Energy Efficiency and Clean Energy Loan
schemes.description: Financing for MSME clean-energy adoption, energy efficiency and rooftop solar.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible MSMEs with viable energy-saving or generation proposals.
schemes.benefits: Dedicated MSME lending with structured repayment.
schemes.rate_note: Indicative sample range; verify with SIDBI.

schemes.name: Green Energy Open Access Framework
schemes.description: Framework enabling consumers above the prescribed threshold to procure renewable power through open access.
schemes.eligibility: Consumers meeting state open-access thresholds and regulatory conditions.
schemes.benefits: Access to renewable power at competitive tariffs with reduced cross-subsidy where notified.
schemes.rate_note: Regulatory framework - not a loan product.

schemes.name: EV Battery Leasing Facility
schemes.description: Battery-as-a-service leasing for electric buses and commercial fleets.
schemes.eligibility: Fleet operators with a viable route plan and maintenance capability.
schemes.benefits: Reduces upfront battery cost and shifts residual-value risk to the lessor.
schemes.rate_note: Illustrative sample product; not a verified live offer.
